items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Clifford Brown; the mention is solely from the interviewer who asks about him.

ctx.x: Raymond Brown. What did he play? Which one? Trombone. Trombone. He's dead now. Yeah.

There's two Raymond Browns, isn't it? His son's name was Raymond too, I think. Yeah. Trombone. Yeah, they called him Clifford or something, didn't they? Clifford Brown. I think his real name was Raymond, somebody told me. I can't remember who told me. I think Andy Anderson. Yeah, he's out of time, isn't he? Clifford? Clifford Brown. I think his real name was Raymond, somebody told me. They just called him Clifford to make the difference for father and son. I can't remember who told me. I think Andy Anderson.…
If I know it, I play it. If I don't, I try to do something else. I see. Do they have to put money in the kitty?
